name: Positional hole: throughAll 8mm-radius bore into an 80x50x15 plate
notes: The through-all half of the hole operation's conformance pair (see hole-blind-plate-r8-d10.json for the blind-depth half). Same plate and bore position/radius as boolean-cut-box-cylinder.json, expressed through the new `hole` operation instead of a manually-placed tool cylinder plus boolean_combine: the placement origin sits on the plate's top face at (15,0,15) with the default drilling axis (-Z) and `throughAll: true`, so the kernel derives its own overshooting tool depth from the target's bounding box instead of a caller-supplied depth. Expected probes are copied verbatim from boolean-cut-box-cylinder.json's `expected` block: a through-all hole and an explicitly-overshot manual cut at the same position and radius must produce bit-for-bit the same solid, which is the whole point of the derived-depth guarantee.
